description: Key package decode and verify in MLS_256_MLKEM1024_AES256GCM_SHA512_MLDSA87 (0xF0AC), the only suite; the AES-128 suites 0x0001 and 0xF0A1 and MOQOM's earlier suites 0xF0AA and 0xF0AB are refused as unsupported. Checks version, suite, identity, ML-DSA-87 signature key, init and encryption keys, signature over KeyPackageTBS, and KeyPackageRef. Failing cases have exactly one defect each.
